import okhttp3.*
import okhttp3.MediaType.Companion.toMediaTypeOrNull
import okhttp3.RequestBody.Companion.asRequestBody
import java.io.File
fun upload(path:String):String{
  val f=File(path)
  val body=MultipartBody.Builder().setType(MultipartBody.FORM).addFormDataPart("file",f.name,f.asRequestBody("image/jpeg".toMediaTypeOrNull())).build()
  val r=OkHttpClient().newCall(Request.Builder().url("{{upload_url}}").post(body).build()).execute()
  return r.body?.string() ?: ""}
